title: Personal Contact Details
description: Personal contact details (name, phone, email and residence address) of an individual.

given_name.title: Given Name
given_name.description: Given name of the individual. Per Schema.org givenName. SHALL be a non-empty string.

family_name.title: Family Name
family_name.description: Family name of the individual. Per Schema.org familyName. SHALL be a non-empty string.

telephone.title: Telephone
telephone.description: Telephone number through which the individual can be contacted. When present, SHALL conform to ITU-T E.164 international public telecommunication numbering plan, including the country code prefix (e.g., +49123456789).

email.title: Email
email.description: Electronic address through which the individual can be contacted. SHALL be a valid email address conforming to RFC 4021.

city_address.title: City Address
city_address.description: The city of the individual's residence.

street_address.title: Street Address
street_address.description: The street address of the individual's residence.

country_address.title: Country Address
country_address.description: The country of the individual's residence, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

nbf.description: Time before which the attestation is not valid, as a NumericDate.

cnf.description: Confirmation claim that binds the attestation to the key of the holder (RFC 7800).

jwk.description: Public key of the holder as a JWK.

status.description: Reference to the Token Status List entry that carries the revocation status of the attestation.

idx.description: Index of the attestation in the status list.

uri.description: URI of the status list token.
